referenceNotes: Record official vs community sources and lessons adapted rather than copied.

layoutDNA.mediaStrategy: The role of media or data visuals.
layoutDNA.responsiveTransformation: How the composition changes on narrow screens.

visualDirection.heroVisual: A large, original editorial photograph paired with a clearly labeled diagram.
visualDirection.graphicLanguage: Captions, folios, index numbers, and a consistent annotation rule.
visualDirection.depthAndMotion: Flat print-inspired surfaces with a short page transition only.
visualDirection.signatureVisual: A repeating visual index that links the image, article, and source evidence.

assetPlan.composition: wide editorial crop with protected focal point

visualDirection.rationale: The surface must lead with the artifact and make the content memorable.

layoutDNA.primaryAnchor: A working collection or direct task.
layoutDNA.primaryRegion: A split visual collection and detail panel.
layoutDNA.responsiveTransformation: Collection becomes a single-column discovery flow.

visualDirection.heroVisual: A strong, full-width subject photograph with an intentional product detail inset.
visualDirection.graphicLanguage: Bold category color fields, precise labels, and asymmetrical photo crops.
visualDirection.depthAndMotion: Layered image planes with reduced-motion-safe transition.
visualDirection.signatureVisual: A consistent product-detail frame that makes comparison easy.
visualDirection.rationale: The subject is visual; the interface should let the work/product speak before reading begins.

layoutDNA.primaryAnchor: A live task/record rather than a promotional headline.
layoutDNA.primaryRegion: A live primary work area with adjacent status/context.
layoutDNA.informationDensity: High but segmented by task importance.
layoutDNA.mediaStrategy: Charts/diagrams only where they reveal state.
layoutDNA.responsiveTransformation: Prioritized task stack with secondary context disclosed.

visualDirection.heroVisual: An accurate real-data visualization or a prioritized live exception queue.
visualDirection.graphicLanguage: Shape-coded statuses, labeled plot families, precise axes, and clear grid structure.
visualDirection.depthAndMotion: Flat technical surfaces with motion only for state change.
visualDirection.signatureVisual: An exception visualization connected directly to the records it summarizes.
visualDirection.rationale: The job is rapid decision-making; the visual system must make status and evidence visible.
